name: NDNL2 -No Dog, No Life-
source:
This story continues the "afterstory" of NDNL.

Following the "joint ownership" ending, broken Madoka is shipped back to her father, who puts a tailplug in her ass, trots her around in public, gives her to other dogs for a gangbang, and other arousing activities.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE147123.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这个故事延续了NDNL的“后记”。

在“共同所有权”结局之后，破碎的小圆被运回她的父亲身边，她的父亲在她的屁股上插了一个尾塞，带着她在公共场合小跑，把她交给其他狗进行轮奸，以及其他令人兴奋的活动。
